request_text: I would like to access all the personal data you hold about me. Please send me a full copy of my records under GDPR Article 15.
notes: Pure access request, no deletion intent.

request_text: My date of birth on file is incorrect. Please correct my personal information to reflect the right date of birth: 15 March 1988.
Please export my data so I can take it to another service. I want a machine-readable download of everything you hold about me.
Please unsubscribe me from all marketing emails and promotional communications. I no longer want to receive newsletters from your company.
notes: Marketing opt-out only, no account deletion.

request_text: Ich möchte mein Konto dauerhaft löschen und alle damit verbundenen persönlichen Daten entfernen lassen. Bitte bestätigen Sie die Löschung.
Veuillez me donner accès à toutes mes données personnelles conformément au RGPD. Je souhaite recevoir une copie de mes informations.
notes: French: GDPR access request only, no deletion.

request_text: I'm deleting my account. You can keep anonymous statistics, but nothing in analytics should still point back to me. Please remove all personal information.
notes: Deletion intent with incidental 'anonymous statistics' and 'analytics' — was incorrectly classified as NOT_APPLICABLE before Phase 1 fix.

request_text: Please delete my account permanently. I know I previously requested an export of my data, but I now want everything erased. Close the account and remove all records.
notes: Mentions 'export' incidentally but primary intent is deletion.

request_text: Before you process the deletion, please make sure you correct any typos in my name in the final audit record. Then delete everything else permanently.
이 계정과 관련된 모든 개인 정보를 영구적으로 삭제해 주세요. 삭제 요청을 처리해 주시기 바랍니다.
I am very unhappy with how my data has been handled. This is unacceptable and I want to make a formal complaint about your data practices.
notes: Complaint only, no deletion intent — should be NOT_APPLICABLE.

request_text: Please remove my name and contact details from the account. You can keep an internal reference for order history but all identifying information must be gone.
notes: Partial deletion / tombstone scenario — still authorizes deletion of personal data.

request_text: Please change the email address on my account and keep all of my records in place.
I cannot access my profile. Please reset my login without closing the account.
Please send me a copy of last year's invoices. Leave my profile and purchase history unchanged.
Please delete my account and personal data, but retain any records that the law requires you to keep.
notes: Explicit deletion request while acknowledging policy-required retention.
